terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using INJAZ, you agree to follow these Terms & Conditions. Please read them carefully before using the platform.

sections.title: Using INJAZ
sections.body: Users are responsible for providing accurate information and using the platform in a respectful and lawful manner.

sections.title: Services
sections.body: Freelancers are responsible for the services they offer and the information they provide about those services.

sections.title: User Accounts
sections.body: Users are responsible for keeping their account information secure and for all activity performed through their account.

sections.title: Prohibited Activities
sections.body: Users must not use INJAZ for fraudulent, illegal, harmful, or abusive activities.

sections.title: Platform Changes
sections.body: INJAZ may update, modify, or remove features of the platform when necessary to improve the service.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about these Terms & Conditions, please contact the INJAZ team.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At INJAZ, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: We may collect information such as your username, email address, profile information, and information related to services and orders.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to provide and improve our services, manage your account, and allow users to connect with freelancers.

sections.title: Information Security
sections.body: We take reasonable steps to protect your information from unauthorized access, modification, or disclosure.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.body: INJAZ may use third-party services to support features such as authentication, image storage, and other platform functionality.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact the INJAZ team.
